entries.reason: Diagnosed 2026-06-23 (not different equilibria): both backends reach the same equilibrium structure (Pearson r~0.999, identical min/max extrema, same argmax), but SOR's update-norm stopping criterion plateaus at gs_residual~4 — far from the true GS solution — so Python and Rust halt ~6% apart in interior L2 and exact-value parity to rtol=1e-3 is not reachable via SOR. Closing it needs a shared GS-residual stopping criterion in both backends (FUSION-canonical solver semantics, coordinated); the multigrid solver is the accurate, converging path. This remains a tracked SOR-equilibrium parity refutation.
